stem: The times, $T$ minutes, taken by a random sample of 75 students to complete a test were noted. The results were summarised by $\sum t = 230$ and $\sum t^2 = 930$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance of $T$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: You should now assume that your estimates from part **(a)** are the true values of the population mean and variance of $T$.
parts.text:
The times taken by another random sample of 75 students were noted, and the sample mean, $\bar{T}$, was found.

Find the value of $a$ such that $\text{P}(\bar{T} > a) = 0.234$.
